title: Measured low-latency mouse navigation and form interaction
steps: Measure click-to-execution and click-to-visible-frame latency on a realistic isolated form, including multiple iframes and slow field reads
Remove blocking focus/audit/control waits from the interactive input path while preserving FIFO barriers and action acknowledgement
Optimize image delivery, mouse semantics and browser event pumping; expose useful end-to-end performance measurements
Verify click, drag, double-click, scroll, text entry, navigation, stale-page protections and final approval; compare baseline/updated measurements
Run required verification and deploy when production work is idle
